question: What supreme attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together.
A great accomplishment is the subject.
This accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs.
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes the practitioner dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
